description: California Transit Routes is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. Provide compiled GTFS schedule data in geospatial format. Transit routes associates route information to shapes. Transit stops associates aggregated stop times and route information for each stop. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are GTFS, Transit, Transit routes, Transit stops, Transportation. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
